title: Cultural Affairs
summary: Cultural governance, Saarang departments, Sangam clubs, and the Club Weekender 2026-27 deck.

posts.md:
Welcome to the Cultural Affairs ecosystem at IIT Madras!

This guide explains how the institute's cultural system is organized—from the governing bodies to Saarang departments and the 16 Sangam clubs.

## Contents

Cultural Governance
Saarang Departments
Sangam Cultural Clubs

Use this guide to understand who manages what and how different teams work together throughout the year.

## Cultural Governance

The administration of cultural activities is handled by multiple leadership teams.

## Executive Committee
- Assists the Cultural Affairs Secretaries
- Structure:
  - 5 Cores
  - 10 Coordinators

## Sangam Cores
**Structure**
- 3 Sangam Cores

**Responsibilities**
- Set the cultural vision
- Manage the Sangam budget
- Organize Freshie Night
- Organize Club Weekender
- Coordinate the Inter-IIT Cultural Contingent
- Liaison between Cultural Secretaries and contingent members

## Board of Culturals (BOC)

**Members**
- Cultural Affairs Secretaries
- Literary Affairs Secretaries
- Social Secretaries
- Sangam Cores
- Cultural Outreach Committee

**Responsibilities**
- Coordinate LitSoc competitions
- Streamline hostel cultural events

## Alumni Committee

Former Cultural Secretaries helping with:
- Sponsorship
- Resources
- Long-term planning
- Knowledge transfer

## Saarang Departments

Saarang is IIT Madras' annual cultural festival and is organized by 11 specialized departments.

## Development & Mobile Operations
Website • Mobile App • Portals • Web3

## Events

Responsible for:
- Competitions
- Workshops
- Spotlight
- Informals
- Meraki
- Saarang Nova

## Facilities & Requirements

Responsible for:
- Logistics
- Procurement
- Vendor Management

## Finance

Responsible for:
- Budget
- Cost Optimization

## Media, Ambience & Design

Responsible for:
- Design
- Photography
- Videography
- Decorations

## Publicity & Hospitality

Promotions • Outreach

## Marketing & Sales

Ticket Sales • Merchandise

## Professional Shows

Responsible for:
- OAT Night Shows
- World Fest

## Quality Management Systems (QMS)

Responsible for:
- ISO Standards
- Sustainability
- Analytics

## Safety & Security

Responsible for:
- Crowd Management
- Artist Security

## Sponsorship & PR

Responsible for:
- Corporate Sponsorships
- Branding
- PR

## Cultural Affairs (Overview)
│
├──  Governance
│   ├── Executive Committee
│   ├── Sangam Cores
│   ├── Board of Culturals
│   └── Alumni Committee
│
├──  Saarang
│   ├── 11 Specialized Departments
│   └── Annual Cultural Festival
│

    ├── 16 Cultural Clubs
    ├── Inter-IIT Cultural Contingent
    └── Year-round Cultural Activities

search_text.title: Sangam Club Weekender 2026-27
search_text.md:
## Sangam (opening) [1–7]
- SANGAM 2026-27: **17 clubs. 200+ events. One goal.** Fun, comps, memories & more!
- LitSoc: the inter-hostel combat!
- Inter IIT: the ultimate!
- **NCA (National Cultural Academy) tracks:** Creative Writing, Dance, Dramatics, Classical Vocals, Western
  Vocals, Guitar, Keyboard, Filmmaking, Fine Arts.

## The Sangam core team [8–10]
- Cultural Secretaries: **Harshit**, Cultural Secretary (Literary); **Devendra**, Cultural Secretary (Arts)
- Sangam Core: **Arya Sadashiv Deshmukh**
- "Follow us maybe hehe"

## Media Club [11–19]
- Instagram: **@mediaclubiitm** (dated 01-08-2026)
- What they do: photography, filmmaking
- What's in store: workshops, short film competitions, photography competitions
- Inter IIT 8.0: online filmmaking, 51-hour filmmaking
- Connect: Instagram, WhatsApp

## Fashion Club [20–27]
- Email: **fashion@smail.iitm.ac.in**
- Heads: **Mehak Sharma**, **Shankar**
- **Festember:** a flagship inter-college stage for the IIT Madras Fashion Contingent: competitive exposure in
  costume design, choreography and runway confidence; a key priority event.
- **Inter IIT:** the peak competitive benchmark; plan to assemble a balanced **18-member team** with
  multi-disciplinary talent (choreography, thematic costumes, storytelling, tech-integrated mechanical/electronic
  props), aiming for a podium finish.
- **LitSoc and Prom:** Panache in LitSoc drives inter-hostel enthusiasm; **Prom Royalty**, held during
  Valentine's Week, is a couples' ramp walk open to the student community.
- Designs & walk; "Fashion family"

## Fine Arts Club [28–43]
- Heads: **Deepika**, **Vishal**
- Coordinators: **Shriya, Kaushik, Varshith, Sasha, Akshaya, Aashish, Meghana**
- "Where imagination meets expectation." The creative heartbeat of IIT Madras, for artists of all skill
  levels, from first-time painters to people refining a digital portfolio.
- 01 Create & Explore: regular hands-on sessions in sketching, canvas painting, digital art and costume design.
- 02 Community & Culture: late-night art jams, campus exhibitions, fun workshops.
- Our artworks: works by the fine arts contingent and arts enthusiasts.
- Events: Art Gallery, Workshops, LitSoc
- Inter IIT 8.0 events: canvas painting, charcoal art, costume design, live sketching
- Join the Fine Arts Freshies group; follow the Insta page.

## Classical Arts Club [44–56]
- Head: **Parasaran**. Coordinator: **Shanmukha**. Team: **Samyuktha, Anudeep, Vyomini**
- About: work with students, professors and residents to bring concerts, workshops and fun events; represent
  Indian classical music and dance in insti.
- Concerts; competitive events and open mics (vocal and instrumental competitions in LitSoc, other events
  through the year)
- Jam sessions: open spaces to practise classical music and dance with peers; open to beginners and trained
  artists.
- Workshops and lecdems (lecture-demonstrations); guided listening sessions by experienced students and
  residents, open to all rasikas.
- Instagram: **@classicalartsclub_iitm**
- What's in it for you: represent insti at Inter IIT and other inter-college fests; perform at events across
  campus (contingent).
- For anyone classically inclined who never learnt formally, or who learnt before and took a break for JEE prep.

## Drama Club [58–77]
- What it offers: lots of "drama", great people, the best of fests, learning the art (with joke captions).
- What you bring: enthusiasm.
- Individual events: mono acting, slam poetry. Team events: mime, nukkad natak (street play), stage play.
- **Achievements:**
  - Inter IIT 7.0: **Gold medal**; Inter IIT 8.0: **Silver medal**
  - Festember (NIT Trichy): Winners 2023, Runners-up 2024
  - Riviera (VIT Vellore): Winners 2026, Best Actress 2025 & 2026
  - Inter IIT 7.0 (IIT Patna): only original script in the top 8, fourth position
  - Productions shown: Stage Coach, Entangled 2025, Opening Night
- **Calendar (2026):**
  - 6 Aug: Drama Initiator ("The Day the Internet Died" by Ian McWethy and Jason Pizzarello, CLT, Thursday
    6/8/26, 8:00 pm)
  - 2nd week of Aug: NCA auditions, Freshie Nite auditions, Festember auditions
  - 3rd week of Aug: Playoffs director selections, Inter IIT director selections
  - 1st week of Sep: Inter IIT club sessions, Inter IIT auditions
  - 2nd week of Sep: LitSoc slam poetry & mono, Playoffs auditions
  - 3rd week of Sep: Freshie Nite drama
  - 4th week of Sep: deputy coord selections, Playoffs

## Music Club [79–93]
- What they do: open mics, Raagabop, studio recordings, LitSoc music events, Battle of the Bands, Acapella
  night (flagship event)
- Contingent performances
- Why join: work with the most talented musicians in insti; learn new instruments through NCA Music and
  workshops; meet people from different musical backgrounds; represent insti at college fests and Inter IIT;
  "if nothing else, a chance to get some hot pfps".
- Upcoming EP. Follow the Insta for updates on everything music in insti; join the freshies group.

## Choreo Club [94–116]
- "Every great dancer was once a beginner, and this is the perfect place to begin."
- Club heads: **Akshitha, Jayadeep, Poorva, Megavarshini**. Deputy club heads: **Janhavi, Prakul**.
  Also listed: **Nishchay, Aman, Ishaan**
- **Frequently with Freakwen(u)c (FWF):** contingent members teach a simple, energetic 1-minute dance to the
  general student body; no experience needed. Previous sessions: Monica, Dhurandhar, Kathu Mela.
- **Spark sessions:** a well-known choreographer teaches beginner routines and the story behind the style.
  Previous styles: hip-hop, popping, breaking, waacking, litefeet.
- **Freshie Night:** perform on stage with your batch; the contingent teaches easy choreographies on trending
  songs.
- **JAM:** the institute's own dance cypher at HFC: freestyle in a circle, no stage, no pressure.
- **Artist sessions:** dance influencers come to IITM to teach choreographies. Previous artists: Karthick Raja,
  Vengayo, Anusha Vishwanathan.
- **LitSoc choreo:** Freestyle Solo (solo competition representing your hostel), Hostel Choreo.
- **Salsa workshop & social:** workshops plus the flagship Salsa Social, led by professional instructors.
- Collabs; contingent fun.
- **Achievements:** Saarang Choreo Night 1st, 2nd and 3rd (several years); Inter IIT Cultural Meet 2nd and 3rd;
  Anna University 2nd and 3rd; Madras Institute of Technology 1st; VIT Vellore 1st; BITS Hyderabad 2nd;
  NIT Warangal 1st; IIT Tirupati 1st; IIIT Sricity 2nd; VNR VJIET 1st; Kurukshaastra 3rd; KMC 3rd.
- Follow us; join now; subscribe.

## Quiz Club [118–143]
- Oldest cultural club in IITM (started with Mardi Gras); a contingent that travels a lot; "most successful
  quizzing society in India".
- Defending champions of the **Inter-IIT Quiz Cup** and the **Inter-IIT Inter-IIM Nihilanth**.
- Wins shown: UTPT Bangalore, Festember Trichy, Inter-IIT Quiz Cup winners, **8-time Nihilanth champions**.
- Runs the Saarang and Shaastra quizzes, Lonewolf @ OAT, Freshie and LitSoc quizzes.
- Upcoming quizzes: Freshie Initiator, Freshie Sports and Games, Freshie Entertainment, Freshie Main Quiz,
  LitSoc Unseeded Fandom, LitSoc Mythomagic.
- "What is quizzing?": sample questions (the Viking Row / Erling Haaland; Matt Damon trying to get home;
  Adyar, Velachery and Tharamani, connected as the IITM gates).

## Word Games Club [145–158]
- Names shown: **Hargun**, **Mia**
- What's the good word? Cryptic crossword, potpourri, Scrabble, spell bee
- Sample puzzles: oronyms (two phrases that sound the same); "Male child, resin; cultural body" = Son Gum;
  Sangam
- Freshie events; Saarang Crossie Open
- WGC Freshies WhatsApp group

## Oratory Club [160–165]
- Debates and informals
- Last year: Freshie Debates, Informals Day, Debate GC, Winter Workshops, IITMPD, JAM panels, debate spars
- **Upcoming (2026–27):** Intro to OC (Aug 2nd week); Seen and Unseen (Sep 4th week); events in Oct 3rd and
  4th week; contingent selection (Dec); Feb 2nd week; JAM panel (Mar 1st week); associate selection (Mar 2nd week)

## Writing Club [170–182]
- "Case closed": Writing Club, Club Weekender 2026, IIT Madras
- WC heads: **Venkata Sai (BE22B042)**, **Abhishek Choudhary (PH23B013)**
- Last year's events; Inter IIT Cultural Meet 8.0 at IIT Kanpur
- How to join: a Google Form for creative-writing entries will be circulated, and members are selected from
  them. Meanwhile, join the freshies' WhatsApp group.

## Spotlight [185–191]
- "Enlighten. Entertain. Empower."
- Talks by icons from cinema, sports, politics, business and more; 15+ personalities every year; fun
  interactions, fireside chats and candid moments. This year: bigger formats, more fun, even higher reach.
- Join the WhatsApp group for updates; follow on Instagram.

## Last club in the deck [200–214]
- "Follow us on Instagram and WhatsApp"
- "We say the same thing as all other clubs too… All you need is… a doctorate in neuroscience. You looking for
  CHAOS and FUN?!"
- The club's name is in an image, so it isn't in the extracted text.
